This is a **chezmoi dotfiles repository**. Source: `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`; target: `~/`; managed files sync via `chezmoi apply` (copies, not symlinks). Repository: https://github.com/pascalandy/dotfiles

Files in `~/` that are managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.

chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc

Prefixes: `dot_` means leading `.`, `private_` means `600`/`700`, `executable_` executable, `symlink_` symlink, `.tmpl` template, `run_before_` before apply, `run_after_` after every apply, `run_once_` first apply.

Store user scripts in `~/.local/bin/`:
code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
Stored as `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`. Ensure PATH:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension.

Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension. Variables go in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`.

See `.chezmoiignore` for exclusions: `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.env*`, `.DS_Store`. See `crash_procedure.md`. Docs: https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/command-overview/

Before solving problems, search cass. ⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5
cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json
cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json
cass capabilities --json
cass robot-docs guide
Use `--fields minimal`, `--limit N`, `--agent NAME`, `--days N`. stdout=data only; stderr=diagnostics; exit 0=success.
